name: Yukiyama Tengaki
source: On the surface, Teno is a third year delinquent at Inova High School. In truth, she is a ghost that only Junjou can interact with. Has a pair of short legs and chubby cheeks. Quietly patrols the school. People often mistake her tendency to space out for hostility. After a while, Junjou realized that Teno is actually very easily embarrassed and clumsy, which makes him want to tease her.
